name: الفئة لتمثيل قرض (الحالة 1)
description:
أنشئ فئة تمثل قرضًا. يجب أن تحتوي هذه الفئة على بيانات تمثل معدل الفائدة، ومبلغ القرض، وطول فترة القرض (بالسنوات)؛ والتي يمكن الوصول إليها أو تغييرها فقط من خلال أساليب getter و setter. ينبغي إنشاء مثيل من الفئة بتحديد معدل الفائدة السنوي، وطول فترة القرض بالسنوات، ومبلغ القرض.  
الطريقة الأخرى في هذه الفئة يجب أن تحسب مبلغ الدفعات الشهرية على القرض.
code:
#Khatwa 1: Tareef al-fasl
class Loan1 :
    #Khatwa 1.1: Ibtida al-qard bi al-qiyam al-muayyana
    def __init__(self, annual_interest_rate, number_of_years, loan_amount) :
        self.__annual_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate
        self.__number_of_years = number_of_years
        self.__loan_amount = loan_amount
    #Khatwa 1.2: Tareef al-tareeqa allathee yahsib mablagh al-dafaat al-shahriya lilqard
    def get_monthly_payment(self) :
        monthly_interest_rate = self.__annual_interest_rate / 12
        monthly_payment = self.__loan_amount * monthly_interest_rate / (1 -
                (1 / (1 + monthly_interest_rate) ** (self.__number_of_years * 12) ))
        return monthly_payment    
    #Khatwa 1.3: Tareef al-tawaariq li-istikhraj/tahdith khasaais al-qard
    def get_annual_interest_rate(self) :
        return self.__annual_interest_rate
    def set_annual_interest_rate(self, annual_interest_rate) :
        self.__annual_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate
    def get_number_of_years(self) :
        return self.__number_of_years
    def set_number_of_years(self, number_of_years) :
        self.__number_of_years = number_of_years
    def get_loan_amount(self) :
        return self.__loan_amount
    def set_loan_amount(self, loan_amount) :
        self.__loan_amount = loan_amount
#Khatwa 2: Ikhtibar al-fasl
annual_interest_rate = float(input("Adkhil muadel al-faida al-sanawi: "))
number_of_years = int(input("Adkhil adad al-sinin li muddat al-qard: "))
loan_amount = (float(input("Adkhil mablagh al-qard: ")))
loan1 = Loan1(annual_interest_rate, number_of_years, loan_amount)
print("Al-dafa al-shahriyya lilqard hiya: {:.2f} ".format(loan1.get_monthly_payment()))

untr_name: The Class for Representing a Loan (Case 1)
untr_description: Construct a class that represents a loan. This class should contain data representing the interest rate, loan amount, and the length of loan period (in years); all of which could be accessed or changed only through the getter and setter methods. An instance of the class should be created by specifying annual interest rate, length of loan period, and loan amount.\nThe other method of the this class should calculate the amount of monthly payments on the loan.
untr_code:
#Step 1: Define the class
class Loan1 :
    #Step 1.1: Initialize the loan with the specified values 
    def __init__(self, annual_interest_rate, number_of_years, loan_amount) :
        self.__annual_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate
        self.__number_of_years = number_of_years
        self.__loan_amount = loan_amount
    #Step 1.2: Define the method that calculates the amount of monthly payments on the loan
    def get_monthly_payment(self) :
        monthly_interest_rate = self.__annual_interest_rate / 12
        monthly_payment = self.__loan_amount * monthly_interest_rate / (1 -
                (1 / (1 + monthly_interest_rate) ** (self.__number_of_years * 12) ))
        return monthly_payment    
    #Step 1.3: Define the methods to get/set the properties of the loan
    def get_annual_interest_rate(self) :
        return self.__annual_interest_rate
    def set_annual_interest_rate(self, annual_interest_rate) :
        self.__annual_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate
    def get_number_of_years(self) :
        return self.__number_of_years
    def set_number_of_years(self, number_of_years) :
        self.__number_of_years = number_of_years
    def get_loan_amount(self) :
        return self.__loan_amount
    def set_loan_amount(self, loan_amount) :
        self.__loan_amount = loan_amount
#Step 2: Test the class
annual_interest_rate = float(input("Enter the annual interest rate: "))
number_of_years = int(input("Enter the number of years for the loan period: "))
loan_amount = (float(input("Enter the loan amount: ")))
loan1 = Loan1(annual_interest_rate, number_of_years, loan_amount)
print("The monthly payment for the loan is: {:.2f} ".format(loan1.get_monthly_payment()))
